adaptation.name: bounded_sign_finite_difference_of_prediction_loss
adaptation.start: first interval boundary strictly after optimizer warmup
adaptation.probe_batch_size: 16 when maximum training target length exceeds 128, otherwise 32; capped at half the training set
adaptation.sampling: independent persistent RNG, disjoint training-only A and B sampled without replacement per probe
adaptation.candidate_update: one exact clipped AdamW update at current learning rate, current moments, common dropout RNG
adaptation.criterion: ordinary one-pass label-smoothed CE on batch B, dropout off
adaptation.restore: model, optimizer, gradients, mode flags, Python/Torch/device RNG; discard both hypothetical updates
